scope: Close a focused 7F.1b schema self-test gap between an available modeler observation with empty payloads and an optional modeler API absent from the build.

positiveModeler: raw byte presence is true and byte count is three
linked data-storage binary-data and record presence are true with byte count two
when the optional DWG ACIS payload API exists, its presence is true and byte count is three
emptyModeler: raw bytes, data-storage bytes, payload ranges, and available DXF payload chunks have zero counts
raw/data-storage/available DWG ACIS presence flags are false
no carrier is emitted for empty payloads
optional API absence remains an explicit excluded field rather than a false zero observation
controls.claimBoundary: Typed observation-presence regression only; it does not establish modeler parsing, ACIS semantics, format parity, or native consumer acceptance.

implementationReadiness.existingOwner: 7F.1b typed schema migration and optional modeler-source observation
